variables.value:
# Instructions
Create a one paragraph executive summary of this content. Include a Best Line Up Front (BLUF) followed by your summary.

# Guidance
## Guidance for writing a good BLUF: 
- Lead with the bottom line — state your main point or decision in the very first sentence.
- Be direct and specific — avoid hedging or vague phrasing.
- Keep it short — 1–2 sentences max for the opening line.
- Provide essential context only after — background, reasoning, or details come later.
- Use plain language — no jargon or filler, make it immediately clear. 
- Don't use the term BLUF in your response. This is just an acronym for our internal use.

## Guidance for writing an executive summary: 
Be clear, concise, and professional. Highlight the main objectives, key findings, and important recommendations or conclusions. Avoid unnecessary detail and keep the tone suitable for senior leadership

## Link to original post
Extract the html link to the original post from the text and include it in your output. Follow the format, <URL|Source>

# Output format
In a nutshell: 
[BLUF]

Executive summary:
[EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY]

<URL|Source>

# Content 
The following is the raw input for you to process according to the above instructions:
{{1.text}}
